_histogram: The histogram is the EXACT live distribution from the widget (147 reviews, mean 4.8571 -> 4.86). The list below is the first page, 22 of 147, so the bars and the star filter tell the same story as the live widget will.

sample.q: I got the putter for my husband. He LOVES it!
Im enjoying the feel and smoothness of my new Lucky putter!
Lucky Golf LGP01 Gold
Shipping was great

Super clean gold color coat i could see my reflection on the bottom side of the head. The weight of the putter was something that I really liked. The dimples on the face for gripping the ball are a really nice touch as well.

When I found this putter online, I was not sure what to expect. The reviews looked great and some commented on the heavier head weight. I bought one because I love the style and a slightly heavier head. When it arrived, I was blown away by how awesome this putter looked and how solid it feels. It sets up square and rolls true. This bad boy will be staying in the bag!!!
If you start making left handed putter I could buy one for myself instead of for other people
It's been cold and snowy here so he hasn't used it much but he's excited to use it when the weather turns. He loves the look of it and has practiced with it in the yard.
Lucky Golf LGP01 Gold

@gabbyelisegolf putt with this now and putts great. She is right eye dominant and can push putts right but the forward face has helped tremendously. She is very happy and ready for her tournaments this year. She is fresh off winning her junior club championship and she has many tournaments to come and she will feel her confident with the lucky putter.

I haven't tried my new lucky putter yet, as I live in a cold climate. But the reason I bought it is because of all the good reviews I read. Christmas morning I held it in my hands and took some practice swings, and I love the weight of it. I'm excited to use it as soon as the courses open!
The look alone is amazing!!! And I haven't putted this good in my life. I should have switched to blades years ago
Love this simple design and happy with my purchase!
The quality and look on this putter is amzing . Everytime i play someone will ask where i bought it .
Looks great. Have yet to use it. Shortly!
Super fast shipping and putter is extremely nice!

It goes without saying the putter is not only stunning but it feels great in the hands too. I received my putter, but there was a small error. There was no head cover in the package. I emailed the service team that evening and by the very next morning they had it resolved. They had responded to my email; and already had a head cover on its way to me.
